description: Start a check of what AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile phones show when a number calls. Returns the test line to call ('dial') for each carrier and a check id (and a token for a keyless check: keep it). The number being checked must then call each test line within the window. The first check on a number is free; later ones need a key with funds.

api_key.description: Optional API key (sia_...), if your connection has none and you got one from get_approval

carriers.description: Leave out to check every carrier that's online

number.description: US 10-digit phone number, any format, e.g. '2145550100' or '(214) 555-0100'

webhook_url.description: Optional https address to POST the finished result to

name: start_check
title: Start a spam label check
